description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProjectPostListener' that extends 'AbstractListener' and handles events related to project posts, such as creating feed updates and managing project milestones when posts are published or unpublished.

classes.name: ProjectPostListener
classes.description: Listener class that handles project post events, creating feeds and managing project milestones upon publishing or unpublishing posts.

methods.name: createFeed
methods.description: Creates feed entries and sends notifications related to a new project blog post, including public and admin feeds, and notifications to investors if applicable.

methods.name: onProjectPost
methods.description: Event handler that responds to project post events, managing project milestones based on post publication status.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns a list of events this listener subscribes to; in this case, handling project post events.
